hero.title: Perfect Fit. Effortless Style. Powered by AI.
hero.description: Your body is unique. Your clothes should be too. Qlozet uses advanced AI to understand your body, your taste, and your lifestyle.

biometric.title: Your Measurements. Instantly.
biometric.description: Forget traditional measuring methods. With just your phone, Qlozet takes your body measurements in about a minute, hands-free, with your phone guiding you by voice.
features: Only an outline leaves your phone

styling.title: Style That Understands You
styling.description: Qlozet’s AI goes beyond numbers. It understands proportion. Every suggestion is grounded in your actual body and taste.

options.title: Fit Guidance
options.description: Cuts and silhouettes that flatter your body type.

options.title: Personalized Feed
options.description: Discover picks tuned to what you love.

options.title: Design Your Own
options.description: Take your fit profile into the bespoke studio.

profile.title: Your Body, Digitally Remembered
profile.description: Once captured, Qlozet builds your personal fit profile, so every future order is faster and easier.

confidence.title: Made for Your Measurements
confidence.description: Less sizing guesswork. Made-to-measure pieces are cut to the measurements you attach, and you can review them before you order.

experience.title: From Scan to Style in Minutes
experience.description: We’ve removed the friction from fashion. Simple. Fast. Powerful.

diversity.title: Real People. Real Bodies. Real Style.
diversity.description: Qlozet is built for diversity across body types, cultures, and fashion preferences.

closing.title: The Future of Fashion Starts With You
closing.description: No more guessing. No more settling. Just clothing made for your body and your taste.
